material.locator: ICA, ISAD(G), Second Edition, §1.1 “Introduction” under “Multilevel Description”; §§2.1 “Description from the General to the Specific” and 2.3 “Linking of Descriptions”.
material.description: The standard describes linked hierarchical descriptions of a fonds and its parts, proceeding from general to specific to represent context and structure. It is a descriptive standard and does not itself determine access rights or legal custody.
